Subject: RE: Eval harness integration notes + infra constraints

Quick tech note (see attached spec):

- Eval harness: will run as a scheduled job inside the customer's Dedicated tenancy. It will support both batch and streaming evaluation. We expect nightly runs to complete within the maintenance window; if Nimble wants real-time regression detection we can add a lower-frequency streaming monitor (5–15 min intervals) but that has cost implications.
- Integration points: a) a signed service account with scoped API keys, b) a mount for the seed corpus (SFTP -> object-store), c) an eval-bucket for artifacts.
- Metrics: we will track per-prompt precision/recall/F1, token consumption, and latency percentiles. The canary gate will consume the nightly F1 delta and a rolling 24h latency signal.
- Rollback automation: we will implement a lightweight orchestrator that flips model routing to previous stable variant and drains existing sessions. Estimated rollback time (test): ~8–12 minutes in our Dedicated infra under typical load. We will instrument a hard kill fallback if safe shutdown exceeds SLA.

Edge cases: if customer-provided labels are sparse for a prompt, we'll fall back to synthetic augmentation and manual review before automated rollback. Documented in attached eval-harness-integration-spec.pdf.

--Karthik
